kdump_crash_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where kdump crash dumps are stored.

kdump_max_mem.description: Maximum memory (in MB) reserved for the crash kernel.

kdump_numcpus.description: Number of CPUs to use for capturing the kdump.

kdump_dump_dump.description: Whether to save the kdump core to disk.

kdump_user_helper.description: Path to the kdump user space helper binary.
